# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Mar 3, 2026)

## OVERVIEW

Today's development focused on enhancing contract security and stability, particularly around interop features and migration processes. Significant effort was also put into improving the robustness of the `op-supernode` and refining testing procedures.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Interop Feature and Contract Migration Enhancements
*   A new custom error `OPContractsManagerMigrator_InteropNotEnabled` was added, and the `migrate()` function now requires the `OPTIMISM_PORTAL_INTEROP` dev feature to be enabled, improving security for interop migrations ([#19285](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19285)).
*   Documentation was added to clarify that guardian pause blocks interop upgrades and that `migrate()` is exclusively for pre-interop chains merging into one set, addressing audit findings ([#19271](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19271)).

### `op-supernode` Stability and Testing Improvements
*   A critical bug causing shutdown hangs in the `op-supernode` chain container was fixed by adding a stop/cancellation check in the `Start()` loop while paused, preventing infinite spinning ([#19365](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19365)).
*   The `TestSupernodeInteropActivationAfterGenesis` test was added to the flake-shake gate in `acceptance-tests.yaml` to improve testing robustness for supernode interop activation ([#19350](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19350)).

### Contract Code Refinement and AI Review Guidelines
*   Duplicated mock logic for `DelayedWETH` and `ETHLockbox` proxy implementations was extracted into a shared `Setup.mockUnoptimizedProxyImplementations()` helper, reducing code redundancy in `contracts-bedrock` tests ([#19349](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19349)).
*   New review rules for "Non-Idempotent Initializers" were added for AI agents in `docs/ai/contract-dev.md` and `ops/ai-eng/graphite/rules.md`, enhancing automated code quality checks ([#19273](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19273)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS

*   **Kona Hardfork and Derivation Pipeline Fixes:** Several PRs address issues within the Kona derivation pipeline, including adding Karst hardfork support ([#19372](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19372)), fixing blob under-fill and over-fill checks ([#19362](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19362), [#19364](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19364)), ensuring proper origin field copying during Holocene transition ([#19360](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19360)), making syscfg update failures non-fatal ([#19358](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19358)), preserving error kinds from chain providers ([#19357](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19357)), accepting EIP-4844 type-3 batcher transactions ([#19355](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19355)), and adding bounds checks in span batch decode ([#19361](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19361)).
*   **Contract and Tooling Updates:** Updates include bumping Solidity versions to 0.8.25 ([#19376](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19376), [#19371](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19371)), removing OPCMv1 entirely ([#19370](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19370)), and updating throttle environment variable names in `op-batcher` documentation ([#19373](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19373)).
*   **Testing and CI Improvements:** New acceptance tests for L2 light CL follow source mode interop were added ([#19378](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19378)), and CI job failure notifications for `contracts-bedrock` now include `@security-oncall` mentions ([#19367](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19367)).
*   **Proxy Admin Test Reuse:** A PR proposes reusing `ProxyAdmin` tests on `L2ProxyAdmin` for backwards compatibility ([#19377](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19377)).

## CLOSED ISSUES

### L2 Contracts Manager (L2CM) Implementation and Design
*   Several issues related to the implementation and design of the L2 Contracts Manager were closed, including the implementation of `ConditionalDeployer` ([#18828](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18828)), the `L2ContractsManager` with an `upgrade()` function ([#18830](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18830)), and the overarching tracking issue for L2 Contract Upgrades Implementation ([#18843](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18843)).
*   The formal specification for client changes related to L2CM upgrades ([#18868](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18868)) and the risk modeling (FMA or threat model) for the L2CM design ([#18869](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18869)) were also closed.

### VM Runner Supernode API Support
*   An issue tracking support for the supernode API in the VM runner was closed as a duplicate ([#19008](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19008)).

## NEW ISSUES

### Kona Derivation Pipeline Anomalies
*   Several issues highlight potential consensus-critical problems in the Kona derivation pipeline, including `CalldataSource` silently dropping EIP-4844 batcher transactions pre-Ecotone ([#19352](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19352)), syscfg update failures being fatal instead of non-fatal ([#19353](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19353)), `BlobSource` wrapping all errors as Temporary, losing `Reset` classification on L1 reorg ([#19354](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19354)), `BatchProvider.attempt_update()` not copying the origin field on Holocene transition ([#19356](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19356)), `BlobData::fill` returning Critical on blob under-fill instead of Reset ([#19359](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19359)), and `BlobSource::load_blobs` silently ignoring over-fill ([#19363](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19363)).

### Interop Transaction Pool and Gas Pricing
*   Documentation is requested for interop transaction pool eviction behavior on reorgs, noting that all interop executing messages are dropped on any reorg ([#19351](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19351)).
*   An investigation is needed into Glamsterdam gas pricing impacts on precompile acceleration, as increased gas costs for precompiles could break proofs ([#19375](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19375)).
*   The `CrossL2Inbox` currently checks gas costs for access list declaration, and there's a proposal to remove this gas introspection ([#19374](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19374)).

### Flashblocks and Karst Upgrade Cleanup
*   A user reported encountering 429 rate limits when connecting to the flashblocks WS endpoint ([#19366](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19366)).
*   After the Karst upgrade is deployed, Karst-specific upgrade transactions should be removed from `GenerateNUTBundle` ([#19369](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19369)).

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### [L2CM Upgrades] Add just command for generating NUT bundles ([#18840](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18840))
The latest comment confirms that the functionality for generating, updating, and verifying JSON NUT bundles via a Solidity script has been included in pull request [#19248](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19248). This indicates progress towards completing the `just` commands for L2CM upgrades.

### kona: orphaned sources/variant.rs in kona-derive references non-existent AsyncIterator and stale API ([#19340](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19340))
The discussion confirms that `rust/kona/crates/protocol/derive/src/sources/variant.rs` is dead code and references non-existent elements. A user offered to fix it, but it was noted that a PR addressing this issue already exists. This indicates that the cleanup of this orphaned file is in progress.
